title: They Told You to Reskill. They Lied by Omission.
description: Preparedness was never on the menu.
excerpt: Nothing says “get it together” faster than the latest investments in making Generative AI shift the way we problem-solve, communicate, learn, and earn. Has a way of really knocking you down a few notches if you’re unprepared, right? Unfortunately, many people have faced this reality check since the end of the global pandemic.
